description: This file defines a PHP interface 'MenuConfigurator' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Menu. The interface specifies a method 'configure' that takes a Screen object and returns a MenuItem object or null. It appears to serve as a contract for configuring menus based on screens in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MenuConfigurator
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for configuring menu items based on screen objects within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines a method that takes a Screen object and returns a MenuItem object or null, used to configure menu entries based on screens.
